title: PLENUM SIDE PANEL
summary: Plenum side panels (the fiberglass side walls at each end of the cowl plenum, ahead of the door hinge pillars), LH/RH, with their bonded-in outer reinforcement, supports and brackets. The panel is bonded to the body (bonds B and E with 56d adhesive); a mounting plate/reinforcement at the top is bolted through to a reinforcement on the other side with screws and nuts, sealed with 73d; a support at the bottom and a reinforcement plate are riveted to the panel.

materials.where: bond line where the plenum side panel [4] joins the body (bond 'E') and at the lower support [9] (LH view)
around the periphery of the mounting plate / outer reinforcement [2] and its attaching bolts [8], each side

fastening.note: Screws [8] go through the outer reinforcement/mounting plate [2] and the panel; nut assemblies [7] on the inner side with reinforcement [3] behind. Holes .192/.218 dia, 4 each side; hole positions dimensioned 17.86, 20.56, 21.80, 21.76.
Outer reinforcement [2] is bonded to the top of the panel at bond line 'B' (no material tag on this bond).
Plenum side panel [4] bonded to the body along its edge at bond line 'E' (56d adhesive tag); bond line 'B' also marked at the panel bottom by support [9].
Rivet [1] goes through support [9], the panel [4] and reinforcement plate [5] on the other side (lower RH view).
LH view: rivets [6] hold bracket [10] to the panel near the round opening; RH view: rivet [6] through the panel flange where the fuse tapping plate (UPC 12) mounts.

notes: NOTE Apply sealer around periphery of mtg. plate and attaching bolts each side as shown.
